class.name: OcgAdaptor3dIsocurve
class.brief_description: Defines an isoparametric curve on a surface. The type of isoparametric curve (U or V) is defined with the enumeration IsoType from GeomAbs if NoneIso is given an error is raised.
class.description: ! Defines an isoparametric curve on a surface. The ! type of isoparametric curve (U or V) is defined ! with the enumeration IsoType from GeomAbs if ! NoneIso is given an error is raised.

method.name: default
method.description: The iso is set to NoneIso.

method.name: Load_1
method.description: Changes the iso on the current surface.

method.name: Load_2
method.description: Changes the iso on the current surface.

method.name: NbIntervals
method.description: Returns the number of intervals for continuity <S>. May be one if Continuity(me) >= <S>

method.name: EvalD0
method.description: Computes the point of parameter theU on the curve.

method.name: Resolution
method.description: Returns the parametric resolution corresponding to the real space resolution <R3d>.

method.name: GetType
method.description: Returns the type of the curve in the current interval: Line, Circle, Ellipse, Hyperbola, Parabola, BezierCurve, BSplineCurve, OtherCurve.
